name: Acetylcarnitine
metabolism: Human metabolism has not yet been verified for this entry. Responsible enzymes, metabolites and elimination routes are not specified. This is a documentation gap, not evidence that the substance is not metabolized; do not infer a pathway from related compounds.
summary: Acetyl-L-carnitine (ALCAR) is an acetylated form of L-carnitine that is produced naturally in the body and sold as a dietary supplement. It is converted back to carnitine in the blood; carnitine helps transport fatty acids into mitochondria for energy production.
